thought: To distinguish the 7th Company Commander (Character 9) from the squad members (who carry rifles) and the Regiment Commander (who is likely older and more strategic/sedentary), I need to emphasize his role as a mid-level field officer. The most historically accurate visual shorthand for a Chinese company commander in 1941 is the Mauser C96 'Broomhandle' pistol in a wooden stock holster. While the squad leader (Ma Baoyu) might have a pistol, the Company Commander's defining look should be sharper, cleaner than the trench-fighting soldiers, yet more active than the Regiment Commander. I will focus on the 'Standard Military Temperament'—rigid posture and the pistol holster as the primary anchor.
distinctive_features: Mid 30s. Sharp, authoritative military bearing. Distinctive wooden Mauser C96 pistol holster on the hip. Leather binocular case.
prompt: Subject: 7th Company Commander of the Eighth Route Army. Action: Standing in a rigid, disciplined attention pose, body slightly angled, radiating a standard military temperament. Key Feature: A distinctive wooden stock holster for a Mauser C96 'Box Cannon' pistol hanging prominently from his leather belt, identifying him as a field officer. Outfit: Faded but neatly buttoned grey-blue cotton uniform of the 1941 Eighth Route Army, wearing a standard soft cap with two buttons, tight leg wrappings (puttees), and black cloth shoes. He also wears a leather binocular case across his chest. Shot & Composition: Full body portrait, slightly low angle to emphasize authority, centered composition. Lighting & Atmosphere: High-contrast dramatic lighting (chiaroscuro), strong key light on the face and the wooden holster, casting deep shadows to sculpt his determined expression. Solemn and decisive atmosphere. Background: Solid, matte dark slate-grey background, ensuring high contrast with the lighter uniform. Style & Medium: Realistic historical film still, highly detailed textures on the wooden holster and fabric, cinematic color grading with desaturated tones. Lens & Focus: 85mm portrait lens, deep depth of field keeping the entire figure in sharp focus.
ref_description: The field officer with a wooden Mauser pistol holster on his hip.
